Before I record the disposition plan, I need input from each of you. Quality — what have you found on the labeling mix-up? Maintenance — anything relevant on your end? Logistics — what's the status of the segregated inventory and any impacts? Product compliance — do you have any findings or concerns? Let's go through each area so I can make an informed decision on the disposition, recovery work, and shipment plan.
